overview_description.description: Yomly is a SaaS company founded in 2018 (originally as EmiratesHR) that provides an all-in-one Human Resource Management System (HRMS) designed for enterprise businesses, particularly in the GCC and MENA regions. The platform enables organizations to streamline and automate HR operations, including employee lifecycle management, payroll processing, recruitment (ATS), performance tracking, attendance, and expense management. It offers a centralized, cloud-based solution that improves efficiency, reduces manual errors, and ensures compliance with regional labor laws such as the UAE Wage Protection System (WPS).
